description:
Check an x402 payment request before signing or paying and return a deterministic PAY, REVIEW or DO_NOT_PAY decision.
USE WHEN: agent needs deterministic verification of a payment requirement before deciding whether to pay.
DO NOT USE WHEN: agent expects this tool to execute the payment.
Offline/read-only preflight: no network calls, signing, settlement, or payment execution. Decision derives from comparing declared intent against the supplied x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED; mismatches yield DO_NOT_PAY, material snapshot changes yield REVIEW, consistency yields PAY.

intent.description: Buyer-declared payment policy: expected seller label, service, resource URL, and optional payment constraints (asset, network, destination, amount, tolerance) used to evaluate consistency against the observed x402 challenge.

expected_amount.description: Optional expected USDC decimal amount, not atomic units.

resource.description: Expected exact absolute HTTP(S) resource URL.

seller.description: Caller-supplied seller label included in the fingerprint; identity is not externally verified.

intent.title: Intent

payment_required.description: Observed x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge decoded as JSON.
payment_required.title: Payment Required

previous_snapshot.description: Optional prior snapshot for stateless material-change detection against a prior result.
previous_snapshot.title: Previous Snapshot

name: x402_payment_preflight_decision

assessment.description: Consistency decision only; never a safety rating.

changes.description: Material changes between current result and previous_snapshot; any change drives REVIEW when no mismatch exists.

checks_performed.description: Consistency checks actually executed for this request.

checks_skipped.description: Checks skipped because the corresponding expected field was not declared in intent.

coverage.description: Scope of the offline comparison: what is and is not evaluated by this preflight.

decision.description: Deterministic preflight payment decision: PAY when intent matches the observed requirement and no material change; REVIEW when consistent but materially changed from previous_snapshot; DO_NOT_PAY when any intent field mismatches the observed requirement.

evidence.description: Derived solely from the supplied intent and payment_required; contains the parsed payment requirement, seller label, and resource domain.

external_calls.description: Always empty in this offline MVP.

matched.description: Intent fields that matched the observed x402 payment requirement.

mismatched.description: Intent fields that mismatched the observed x402 payment requirement; any mismatch drives DO_NOT_PAY.

payment_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of canonical material payment fields.

reason_codes.description: Machine-readable codes explaining the decision; mismatch codes when DO_NOT_PAY, change codes when REVIEW.

snapshot.description: Reusable stateless comparison state for detecting material changes on a subsequent call.

title: x402 Payment Preflight Decision
